name: Markdown.vue
description:
# Conversation Summary

1. The `Markdown` component emits a `text-changed` event when its content is modified via code block editing, carrying the updated full markdown text.
2. The event chain needed wiring through the component tree: `Markdown` → `Document` → `ChatEntry` → `ChatMessageList` → `Chat`.
3. `Document.vue` was updated to forward the `text-changed` event from `Markdown` up to `ChatEntry`.
4. `ChatEntry.vue` handles `text-changed` via `onDocumentTextChanged`, updating `displayMessage.content` and emitting `message-changed` with `{ doc_id, content }`.
5. `Chat.vue` handles `message-changed` via `onMessageChanged`, calling `chatSvc.updateExistingMessage` followed by `saveChat()` to persist the change to the server.

messages.content: When Markdown emiots text change, the ChatEntry must emit message-changed and chat must "save" the chat message.
